Wholesale Application

Fill out the form below to apply for a Cedar Fort wholesale account. Once approved, you will receive your Cedar Fort Customer ID by email and can log in to place orders through this portal.

Pricing & Discounts

Cedar Fort offers wholesale partners 40% off retail price on book products and 50% off retail price on Pioneer/gift items (SKUs beginning with "P"). Wholesale pricing is applied automatically when you place an order through this portal.

Payment Terms

Net 30 terms.

  • Invoices are sent automatically to the billing email on file.
  • Pay by card: Payment Portal
  • Pay by phone: Accounts Receivable at 801-489-4084
  • Pay by check: "Cedar Fort, Inc." — 2373 W 700 S, Suite 100, Springville, UT 84663
  • Late fee: 1.5% finance charge on overdue invoices.
Shipping

We ship via UPS, FedEx, or USPS — our system selects the most affordable carrier and includes freight on your invoice. If you have a carrier account you'd like us to bill, include the account number in your order notes.

Placing Orders

Order directly through this portal or by emailing [email protected] and copying [email protected]. Include: (1) product title, (2) product code/ISBN/UPC, (3) desired quantity. Need help? Call 801-489-4084.

Returns
  • Saleable returns accepted up to 365 days for store credit (no credit for return shipping).
  • Flash deals, close-outs, and promotional items are non-returnable.
  • All returns require an approved Return Authorization Number (RA#) before shipment.
  • 10% restocking fee applies. No cash refunds.
  • To request a return, email [email protected] with: product title, SKU/ISBN, quantity, and per-item price paid.
Tax Exemption

Utah customers: complete and sign form TC-721 and submit with your application. Out-of-state customers: send your state's tax-exempt form to [email protected].

Utah customers: download, complete, and email your signed TC-721 to [email protected]. Out-of-state customers: send your state's equivalent form.
